Boundaries Crossed

Released November 7, 2012 · 153 cards

Expanded

Boundaries Crossed is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Black & White series, released in English on November 7, 2012. Its main set has 149 cards, plus 4 secret rares numbered beyond the set (153 in total). It includes 135 Pokémon, 18 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).
